title: The crossroad Part 1
author: Asjad Ullah
description: Mia wants to exploit a pre-marriage contract with her millionaire husband, Jones. She sets him up, so she could grab all his wealth, and enjoy life with her boyfriend Dan. But things go out of control, leaving everyone flabbergasted!

messages.text: Hey baby.
I’ve set the trap for my husband.
You’re such a bitch. ;P
I’m impressed.
I couldn’t have done it without you.
I just added the toppings.
Yeah, but that bombshell Sandy you recommended.
I bet my husband will start drooling the moment he sees her.
Hahaha…
Yeah, he’s such a loser.
Sandy is the best in the business.
We’re so near to our dream Dan.
I can’t wait to get my hands on that hag’s money.
Yeah, all the money will be ours.
Yeah, once we catch him with his pants down, literally.
You know what I think at times?
What?
What a douche your husband is.
He’s a millionaire and still signed such a contract.
He was blinded by my love back then.
We agreed that we won’t cheat.
And when we catch him cheating…wham!
Here comes the money.
How much did you pay Sandy?
We agreed upon 50 grand.
Have you made the payments?
I was hesitant to pay in full.
But I had to, there was no choice.
Ok.
And what about your lawyer?
She’s ready too.
Oh my, I’m so excited.
So am I dear, So am I!
So here’s the plan.
Sandy has set-up a meeting with him tomorrow.
They will meet in a hotel.
Sandy will seduce Jones, and take some pictures as evidence.
She’ll send us his pictures the day after.
Then it’ll be your job.
I’ll be ready with our transport.
And we’ll head straight to the Island.
And my lawyer will do the cleaning up.
I guess we’ve nailed it then.
Just a matter of time now.
Yeah, Jones will be nailed.
In every way possible.
